SUPERSEDES_CANDIDATE.REASON: Repairs independently reviewed Universe/Projection interop, root/count binding, taxonomy-identity, and dedup-parent determinism blockers. V2 remains durable history.

PURPOSE: Deterministically derive CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 and atomically bind OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT to the same hashed projected manifest using one exact Universe V3 + adapter generation and independently reviewed semantic classification.

SNAPSHOT_BINDING.RULE: Every projection input, semantic record, review and dedup decision must resolve inside one pinned control commit/tree or be content-addressed by an immutable blob/hash explicitly included in this snapshot identity. Any mismatch => UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.

RAW_NORMALIZATION.finding_id: Exact adapter output. Must be non-empty, already NFC, no leading/trailing Unicode whitespace.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.finding_blob_sha: Exact adapter output lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.type_raw: Exact adapter output string or null. No semantic inference.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.severity_raw: Exact adapter output string or null. No trimming/case folding.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.status_raw: Exact adapter output string or null. No trimming/case folding.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.null_rule: Missing/null/malformed authority-bearing values never receive permissive normalization.

P0_CLASSIFICATION.EXACT_P0_RULE: A well-formed severity_raw exactly present in EXACT_P0_VARIANT_MAP => P0. This classification cannot be downgraded by any semantic record.
P0_CLASSIFICATION.NON_EXACT_RULE: A severity_raw not in EXACT_P0_VARIANT_MAP, or null/malformed severity, is UNKNOWN unless one highest-generation VALID semantic classification record independently reviewed at the same snapshot supplies p0_classification_override=P0 or NOT_P0.
P0_CLASSIFICATION.OVERRIDE_RULE: p0_classification_override is permitted only for non-exact-P0 severity. Conflicting highest-generation valid overrides => UNKNOWN.
P0_CLASSIFICATION.FREE_TEXT_RULE: Free-text P0 mentions outside authoritative severity and reviewed semantic evidence never establish class.

STATUS_CLASSIFICATION.RULE: terminal_nonblocking=true only when status_raw is a well-formed NFC string exactly equal case-sensitively to one TERMINAL_NONBLOCKING_EXACT value.
STATUS_CLASSIFICATION.FAIL_CLOSED: All other status values, including null, missing, ACKNOWLEDGED, AUTHORITY_CORRECTION, REPRODUCED, RESOLVED_* variants, OPEN_* variants and unknown strings are terminal_nonblocking=false.

RULES.CONTROL_BLOCKER: Requires a highest-generation VALID semantic classification record proving the finding independently affects admission, target/law/spec authority, control integrity, gates, leases, integration authority, closure authority, canonical roots, resource/shard authority, control transport, or other preactivation control correctness.
RULES.PRODUCT_ONLY: Requires a highest-generation VALID semantic classification record proving normal product implementation is the resolution and the finding does not independently affect activation/control authority.
RULES.SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE: Requires a highest-generation VALID semantic classification record plus one VALID dedup decision meeting DEDUP_DECISION_SCHEMA and CROSS_RECORD_CONSISTENCY.
RULES.HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING: Requires terminal_nonblocking=true plus a highest-generation VALID semantic classification record proving the finding is historical/noncurrent for control authority.
RULES.UNKNOWN: Any absent, stale, malformed, conflicted, self-reviewed, or insufficient record.

FIELD_TYPES.control_relevance: CONTROL_RELEVANCE enum except UNKNOWN is not a certifying value

EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.source_path: normalized repository path or pinned-spec logical identifier
EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.source_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA; for AUTHORITATIVE_SPEC_REFERENCE use exact lowercase 64-hex pinned spec SHA-256
EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.statement_sha256: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of UTF8(NFC(canonical evidence statement))

VALIDITY_RULES: finding_id/path/blob exactly equal the adapted-universe row.
classifier_chat_id differs from independent reviewer chat identity.
independent review binds classification_record_id, record_generation, finding_blob_sha, p0_classification_override, control_relevance, and exact evidence hashes with verdict PASS.
p0_classification_override must be NONE when severity_raw is exact-known P0; any attempted downgrade invalidates the record.
control_relevance=SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE additionally requires a VALID dedup decision.
control_relevance=HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING is valid only when terminal_nonblocking=true.
If multiple highest-generation VALID records disagree on override or control relevance, classification becomes UNKNOWN.
A lower-generation record is superseded only by a strictly higher VALID record for the same finding_id.
Supporting and canonical findings each exist exactly once in the same adapted universe.
Independent reviewer differs from classifier and binds the exact decision generation/content with PASS.
No dedup chains or cycles: canonical parent control_relevance must be CONTROL_BLOCKER, never SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE.
Supporting finding p0_classification must be P0.
Canonical parent p0_classification must be P0.
Canonical parent control_relevance must be CONTROL_BLOCKER.
If supporting terminal_nonblocking=false, canonical parent terminal_nonblocking must also be false; otherwise decision invalid and projection UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.
Missing parent, blob mismatch, conflicting highest-generation decisions, stale review, chain, cycle, or parent-class mismatch => UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.

CROSS_RECORD_CONSISTENCY: A PRODUCT_ONLY or HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING row cannot be a canonical dedup parent.
A NOT_P0 or UNKNOWN p0 row cannot be a canonical dedup parent.
A SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE row must resolve directly to one P0 CONTROL_BLOCKER parent in the same pinned manifest.
An open supporting row cannot be hidden behind a terminal-nonblocking parent.

INPUT_MANIFESTS.FINDING_UNIVERSE: Must PASS exact REQUIRED_INPUT_ARTIFACTS.FINDING_UNIVERSE_CONTRACT and produce validation_summary.complete=true.
INPUT_MANIFESTS.ADAPTED_UNIVERSE: Must PASS exact REQUIRED_INPUT_ARTIFACTS.UNIVERSE_ADAPTER with adapter_status=VALID.

CLASSIFICATION_MANIFEST.ROW_SORT: finding_id UTF-8 bytes, record_generation ascending, classification_record_id UTF-8 bytes

DEDUP_DECISION_MANIFEST.ROW_SORT: supporting_finding_id UTF-8 bytes, record_generation ascending, dedup_decision_id UTF-8 bytes

FIELD_TYPES.finding_universe_contract_blob_sha: exact required contract lowercase 40-hex blob SHA
FIELD_TYPES.universe_adapter_blob_sha: exact required adapter lowercase 40-hex blob SHA
FIELD_TYPES.projection_schema_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex blob SHA of this exact V3 schema
FIELD_TYPES.source_row_count: non-negative JSON integer equal adapted-universe row count
FIELD_TYPES.open_control_p0_count: non-negative JSON integer when projection_status=VALID; exact JSON null when UNKNOWN_BLOCKING

PROJECTED_MANIFEST.ROW_INCLUSION: Emit one row for every adapted-universe row whose p0_classification is P0 or UNKNOWN. NOT_P0 rows remain durably represented by source_row_count/classification manifests but are not projected rows.
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.SORT: dedup_key UTF-8 bytes, then finding_id UTF-8 bytes, then finding_path UTF-8 bytes
UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_TRIGGERS: p0_classification UNKNOWN for any source row
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.HASH_RULE: CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH = SHA-256(UTF8(RFC8785_JCS(ROOT_OBJECT))) lowercase 64-hex only when projection_status=VALID. When UNKNOWN_BLOCKING, CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH=null for activation authority.
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.COUNT_BINDING_RULE: open_control_p0_count is inside ROOT_OBJECT and therefore cryptographically bound to CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH. A validator MUST recompute the count from rows and reject any mismatch before accepting the root.

COUNTING.OPEN_BLOCKER_ROW_RULE: A canonical projected row is open-control-P0 iff p0_classification=P0, control_relevance=CONTROL_BLOCKER, and terminal_nonblocking=false.
COUNTING.SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE_RULE: A valid SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE never increments independently; its dedup_key points directly to a valid P0 CONTROL_BLOCKER canonical parent. Dedup invalidity => UNKNOWN_BLOCKING, never silent exclusion.
COUNTING.PRODUCT_ONLY_RULE: PRODUCT_ONLY P0 rows do not increment open_control_p0_count but remain in projected rows/evidence.
COUNTING.HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING_RULE: HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING is valid only with terminal_nonblocking=true and does not increment count.
COUNTING.OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT: When projection_status=VALID, count unique dedup_key values whose canonical parent row satisfies OPEN_BLOCKER_ROW_RULE. This exact integer MUST equal PROJECTED_MANIFEST.open_control_p0_count.
COUNTING.ZERO_PROOF: OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0 is provable only when projection_status=VALID, all input manifests/reviews validate, CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH recomputes exactly, and the root-bound open_control_p0_count is exactly integer 0.

FAIL_CLOSED: Partial search or partial shard coverage never proves zero.
No unbound severity/status taxonomy is permitted.
Resolved-like status prefixes never become terminal automatically.
Known exact P0 severity can never be downgraded.
Unknown severity requires independently reviewed semantic override or remains UNKNOWN.
Product-only classification without independent review is UNKNOWN.
Duplicate mapping without independently reviewed exact evidence is UNKNOWN.
An open supporting duplicate cannot be hidden behind a closed/non-control/non-P0 parent.
Any stale or mixed-snapshot evidence makes projection UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.
No status/finding may be mass-closed or mass-superseded merely to reduce the count.
